answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 115 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the summit. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the echo queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The walnut index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The fee repeats 13 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
